capabilities: Discover WLED devices on the local subnet via HTTP scan or mDNS, or add them by IP address
Control color, brightness, presets, segments and on/off in real time over WebSocket
Toggle devices from ribbon icons, status bar entries, or commands with hotkeys
Open a device's web dashboard in a browser or embedded in-app tab
Define custom effect states and sequences with wled-effect codeblock buttons
extras: Not yet on the Obsidian Community Plugins list; manual installation from releases is required. README warns it is beta software, largely untested, with no warranty, and recommends backing up the vault. Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true); USB serial control is experimental and macOS/Linux only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to control smart lighting hardware, so users must leave the app or open WLED's own web interface to change their lights.

relations.evidence: Control WLED LED controllers on your local network directly from Obsidian

summary: Hardware control plugin that manages WLED LED strip controllers on the local network, adjusting color, brightness, presets, segments and power.
